summary: The lesson repeats the tradeoff but neither explains nor depicts the mechanism, and its speech is far short of the requested scope.

Carry this mechanism into beat-3 so narrowing the same passage visibly explains both restrictions; distinguish overall movement from a one-way valve. The richer keyPoints and entity descriptions do not supply the missing viewer-facing reasoning.

The complete script has only 72 spoken words and no pauses, estimating about 32-38 seconds at 150-125 words per minute including the prescribed 10% allowance, substantially below roughly two minutes. Use the available duration to develop the missing causal explanation and its dry-condition application across the three scenes, rather than padding the repeated conclusion.
